scope: Proposition 3.4 of the manuscript “A counterexample to Hadwiger's conjecture” (preprints/A-counterexample-to-Hadwigers-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 157 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a97293542586d351), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume the conclusion of Theorem 3.1 at a given sufficiently large n. For m = 2C0gN , the sampled graph defined in Section 2 satisfies α(G) ≤ 2, cm(G) < m/100 with probability 1 − exp(−Ω(m)). The implied positive constant is independent of n.
